analysis.summary: Canarys Automations reported its H2 and FY26 financial performance, highlighting consolidated revenue reaching nearly INR200 crores and standalone revenue crossing INR100 crores for the first time. The company is actively executing a strategic pivot from a traditional services partner to an AI-native engineering and solution resilience platform, driven by its proprietary CAR framework and software products like AURYIS. Management noted that while integration costs and talent investments temporarily impacted margins in FY26, operating leverage and scaling of subscription-based products are expected to drive margin expansion and growth over the next 12 to 24 months. The total order book stands at approximately INR441 crores, providing medium-term revenue visibility supported by strong international operations and high-value partnerships. Canarys Automations Limited released its investor presentation for FY26, reporting significant operational and financial milestones, including surpassing Rs 100 Cr in standalone revenue and Rs 200 Cr on a consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Management targets a bare minimum revenue growth of 20% for the upcoming period while aiming for higher growth.
guidance.quote: It should be. We are targeting a little higher as well. But at a bare minimum, yes, 20% is quite achievable, but we are targeting for higher growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that the project pipeline is strong with multiple active opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Pipeline is pretty strong. We are working on multiple project opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that AI is a market disruption and that customers constantly ask if the company has an AI practice.
demand_outlook.quote: AI, it is a disruption happening in the market and any new customer the first thing they ask is do you have AI practice and if yes, what kind of practice, right?

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that most projects delivered today are AI driven.
demand_outlook.quote: So, most of the projects are AI driven today, whatever we deliver.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025, significantly strengthening Canarys' presence in the North American technology services market.

capex_expansion.claim: The strategic acquisition of Fortira, a U.S.-based AI, data, digital engineering, and IT consulting firm, was completed in April 2025 for a 51% stake.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed this acquisition in April 2025 for a 51% stake, underscored our transition from a local solutions company to a global, active, innovation-driven technology enterprise.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin improved to 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margin improved to 17% through operational efficiencies, execution excellence, and AI-enabled productivity initiatives.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins experienced moderation due to strategic growth investments, integration costs, and talent onboarding.
margins_costs.quote: Strategic growth investments, including integration costs and talent onboarding, led to a moderation in EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR 13 crores with a 13% margin, reflecting a slight expected dip due to strategic investments.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA stood at INR 13 crores with a 13% margin. There is a slight dip in margin, which was expected as we made strategic investments in team expansion, product development, and global scaling.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that senior leaders are being brought into the system, which contributes to the company's costs.
margins_costs.quote: Because we are also bringing quite a lot of senior leaders into the system. As we grow, right, you also need good senior leaders into the system. And these senior leaders, you know the cost, right, so today, they are expensive.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at approximately INR441 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at approximately INR441 crores, giving us healthy revenue visibility for the years ahead.

orders_capacity.claim: Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores to the order book, Fortira adds INR207 crores, and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores, nearly doubling from INR105 crores in FY '25. Fortira adds INR207 crores and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Standalone FY26 revenue crossed Rs 100 Cr, with IT solutions forming 86% and Water Resource Management forming 14%.
orders_capacity.quote: Crossed Rs 100 Cr in Revenue, supported by strong execution across Technology Solutions and AI-powered offerings. Of the total revenue, IT Solutions formed 86% while Water Resource Management formed 14%

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated FY26 revenue reached the Rs 200 Cr milestone, with IT solutions at 93% and Water Resource Management at 7%.
orders_capacity.quote: Reached the Rs 200 Cr revenue milestone, driven by the Fortira Inc.’s acquisition, strong growth in Technology Solutions, and continued expansion across key industry verticals. Of the total revenue, IT Solutions formed 93% while Water Resource Management formed 7%.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stands at a healthy INR 208 crores, with INR 151 crores from the technology solutions vertical and INR 57 crores from water resource management.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book now stands at a healthy INR 208 crores, out of which INR 151 crores from technology solutions vertical, a significant rise from INR 105 crores in FY '25, and INR 57 crores from water resource management.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio remains low at 0.1x.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-to-equity ratio remains very low at 0.1x, underlying our conservative and healthy capital structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Growth in profit after tax was impacted by a onetime exceptional item related to the implementation of labour code provisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR10 crores. Growth here was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Standalone PAT growth was impacted by a one-time exceptional loss related to labor code provisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to the implementation of labour code provisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Water resource management projects involve longer payment cycles, leading the company to take a more focused approach.
risks_headwinds.quote: These projects have strengthened our expertise, but given longer payment cycles, we now take a more focused approach choosing opportunities that offer speed, scale, and better commercial outcomes.

management_commitments.claim: Margin correction for Fortira to build traction and change margins will take 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: So it would take at least 12 to 18 months for us to really build the traction and change the margins.

management_commitments.claim: One of the key goals for FY '26 is to train 25% of the team in AI, ML, and data skills.
management_commitments.quote: One of our key goals for FY '26 is to train 25% of our team in AI, ML, and data skills to strengthen our leadership in emerging technologies.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
